fact: The Baxnaano page says all UCT payments are sent by mobile money to the household's registered phone number.

The Baxnaano page says the Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs' unconditional cash transfer pays 50,000 of the poorest households in 21 districts US$20 a month, disbursed quarterly to the mobile number registered at enrolment.
The World Bank's ISR says the Baxnaano Management Information System is in development, with the national cash transfer MIS indicator marked 'In Progress'.
